stemMd: A real number satisfies −2 < x < 1. Which interval must contain 3 − 2x?
explanationMd: Multiplying −2 < x < 1 by −2 reverses the inequalities, giving −2 < −2x < 4 when reordered. Adding three gives 1 < 3 − 2x < 7. Strictness is preserved.

distractorRationale.c: This does not correctly transform both endpoints.
distractorRationale.e: This reverses the sign of the whole expression.
distractorRationale.b: Values of x close to −2 give 3 − 2x greater than six, so this upper bound fails.
distractorRationale.d: This wrongly excludes valid values near the transformed endpoints.
